description: Erection of a rear roof dormer extension and second floor extension to the two storey rear outrigger, installation of two front roof lights and replacement of the house's single storey rear extension sliding rear doors.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the rear roof dormer extension, second floor extension to the two storey rear outrigger, altered existing single storey rear extension and two front roof lights hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing house.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (ST_NOV17_6 DALE_00; ST_NOV17_6 DALE_01 (Rev J); ST_NOV17_6 DALE_02 (Rev J)  Received:  27 May 2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the proposed rear roof dormer extension and second floor extension to the two storey rear outrigger, or the altered existing single storey rear extension hereby approved.
